Discover the charm of historic buildings and alleyways in central Hanno on this guided walking tour.

A local architect will introduce you to Hanno's historical architecture and the character of its streets and laneways.

【Fee】6,000 yen per person (includes guide, materials, lunch, building access, insurance, and other costs)

【Capacity】7 people

【Guide】Asano Masatoshi (Advisor, Hanno Machinakagenki Association; Licensed Architect, First Class)

【What to bring】Drinking water, rain gear, writing materials

For more information and to register, visit the Hanno Eco-Tourism Association website: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-machinakagenki-kominka/
